summary: Create a key/value secret named exactly secrets-rhaap-portal in the portal project with keys aap-host-url, oauth-client-id, oauth-client-secret and aap-token (a token with read access).
questions: Which keys go into the portal AAP authentication secret?

answer_card.title: secrets-rhaap-portal
answer_card.answer_md:
Key/value secret in the portal project, with this **exact** name and keys:

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| `aap-host-url` | AAP instance URL |
| `oauth-client-id` | OAuth application client ID |
| `oauth-client-secret` | OAuth application client secret |
| `aap-token` | AAP API token (needs `read` access) |
